_comment_: Fill this with one real Safina-signed transaction from their side. Then run: docker exec orgon-backend python backend/scripts/safina_discover_canonical.py --sample /path/to/this.json — the script probes all 6 canonical-payload variants and tells which one matches. After that: set SAFINA_CANONICAL_VARIANT=<matched> and ORGON_SAFINA_VERIFY_MODE=shadow in Coolify env, redeploy, soak 24h, then switch to enforce.
signature_hex: <paste signed[i].ecsign — concat of r:32 + s:32 + v:1 as 0x-prefixed hex>
expected_signer: <paste signed[i].ecaddress — the 0x... address that should recover from the signature>
